title: Stock Market Crash Coming? Inflation Is the Trigger!
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: Inflation breadth is narrowing and cyclical components are falling, but Middle East conflict keeps oil, the main inflation driver, higher for longer.
Consensus expects CPI in line with core measures trending down; he would not hold big positions into the print.
S&P breadth bounced off the 18% extreme zone and historically recovers toward 50% before retesting, so the index can grind higher.
A private Anthropic investor meeting ahead of a possible November IPO could cause volatility as details leak.
Cost of capital is becoming a bigger constraint on AI build-out than wafer and memory shortages.
JPM and Citi earnings were not good and investors sold financials even on Goldman's beat.

calls.reason: S&P breadth bounced from the extreme 18% zone; historically it recovers to ~50% above the 50-day before retesting, and the S&P should outperform the Nasdaq relatively.
calls.quote: You're only at 38. So, I do think you can grind higher.

calls.condition: Swing longs in tech only once more than 50% of NDX is above its 50-day moving average.
calls.reason: QQQ is holding the gap after a retest but NDX breadth is trapped below 50% above the 50-day; direction into CPI/ASML is 'anyone's guess'.
calls.quote: Now, coming into tomorrow, it's anyone's guess what happens.

calls.condition: Trade semis off options put walls: put walls act as either support or resistance.
calls.reason: Semis held the 55-day and closed back over it (likely short covering), but the chart failed a breakout with RSI rolling over; new put wall at 500. He shorted SOXL but trimmed into events.
calls.quote: You tried to break out, you absolutely failed, your RSI is rolling over.

calls.reason: RSI bounced off 50 and crude is breaking a small downtrend; Middle East conflict is expanding and he cites a forecast of oil $20-25 higher.
calls.quote: barring some massive like peace deal, it seems to me like we're going to take that out, like we're going to grind higher.

calls.instrument_quoted: XOM (with CVX and integrated energy names)
calls.reason: Energy sector breaking out of an upper channel with RSI breaking through; Exxon and Chevron at all-time highs and integrated names benefit from oil higher for longer, likely showing in earnings.
calls.quote: You could be setting up for another leg in energy here.

calls.reason: 10-year yield looks to have peaked at the 535 level, which is lifting utilities (XLU).
calls.quote: you're watching TNX. It looks like it peaked at that 535.

notes: No date stated; recorded after the close the day before CPI, ASML earnings and an Anthropic investor meeting, on the day of JPM/Citi/Goldman earnings, so likely 2026-10-13 (listing approx 2026-10-14). TNX '535' is as spoken (units unclear). MU, SNDK, STX, NBIS mentioned only as intraday put-wall trades already closed; skipped. XLU called 'fantastic' and financials weak but not given as forward calls.
